method.headline_jsd: arithmetic mean of eight 1D marginal divergences; not joint 8D JSD
method.density: Gaussian-smoothed weighted histograms on common prior support; reflected nonperiodic and wrapped periodic boundaries
method.bandwidth: per-event, per-parameter reference Scott bandwidth shared by all three estimates; comparison only, never sampler training/tuning
method.grid: 512–8192 bins, at least four bins per bandwidth unless the recorded floor binds
method.calibration: disjoint reference splits matching the cheap draw count; descriptive 5/50/95 percentiles, not confidence bounds or a bias correction
limitations: Marginal JSD misses correlations and depends on density-estimation resolution.
Unequal sample sizes and correlated NIS particles affect JSD; the calibration only matches cheap sample size.
Reported evidence errors exclude sampler/proposal/recovery bias; stopping thresholds do not certify convergence.
Reference posteriors are thinned to 1000 retained draws per event; reference is finite-sampling, not exact truth.
